concerns.text: Task T034 explicitly forbids calculating 'partial η²' ('DO NOT calculate partial η²'), directly violating Spec FR-004 which mandates reporting 'Cohen's d, partial η²'. This is a semantic weakening of a functional requirement.

Task T026a mandates raising a 'RuntimeError' if real data is missing and '--null-effect' is not set. This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which requires the pipeline to run on a fresh GitHub Actions runner. The task blocks CI execution unless data is pre-seeded, contradicting the 'Reproducibility' requirement that the code must run end-to-end without manual intervention.

Task T007 defines the 'ParticipantResponse' model with fields 'reaction_time' and 'is_correct' (implied by context but missing in explicit list) but omits 'timestamp' which is explicitly required in Spec Section 3 ('ParticipantResponse: ... timestamp'). The task description lists 'reaction_time' instead of 'timestamp', creating a data model mismatch that violates the spec's defined schema.

Task T055 is marked as unchecked [ ] in the final phase, yet it is critical for Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) to verify end-to-end determinism. Leaving this task unimplemented in the final task list constitutes a dropped acceptance criterion for the reproducibility requirement.
